title: Exclusive: Estée Lauder Companies’ Senior VP & General Manager, UK & Ireland, steps down
summary: Pernilla Nyberg has resigned as Estée Lauder Companies’ Senior VP & General Manager, UK & Ireland, and will be succeeded by Umair Ansari, who is currently serving as the company’s Senior VP & General Manager, Travel Retail EMEA & Americas

extraction.key_fact: 에스티 로더 컴퍼니즈의 영국·아일랜드 총괄이 사임하고 후임이 정해졌다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Pernilla Nyberg has resigned as Estée Lauder Companies’ Senior VP & General Manager, UK & Ireland
